assign.request: let's make a site-wide right "dev" toolbar.  CTRL + \ will activate it, and it should use localstorage to remember activation state, it should ahve an X to close it — let's go dark UI theme for this one.

steps: Scope the shell: --drawer, ext/layout panel, Socket, Router
DevBar shell — fixed right rail, header, ✕, mounted from app.js

Push the shell without breaking ext/layout's drawer

log.msg: The right edge is already claimed: ext/layout's drawer is fixed at inset-inline-end 0 and pushes the shell with --drawer, read by .app in framework.css. A second right rail sharing that token would silently lose its push the first time the layout drawer closed (deselect() clears --drawer). Plan: the bar owns its own --devbar rail; the shell sums the two.

assign.now: Built and verified in the browser — writing the docs

log.msg: Verified with playwright at 1600 and 480: ctrl+\ toggles, localStorage survives a reload, ✕ closes, the shell pushes 272px (17rem) and clamps to 64px at 480 as designed. Both right drawers coexist — layout panel at x1024/304 beside the rail at x1328/272, .app padding 576px, and Escape closes only the layout one. No console errors.

Two real bugs caught by the browser, not by reading: (1) `input.attr(...)` — `input` is a FACTORY, not a view, so it threw inside App.render() and the whole site failed to boot, but ONLY on a reload with the rail restored open. (2) the crumbs lagged one navigation: Router.go() pushes history AFTER the load, so location.pathname is stale during navigated() — the active page's `url` is the right source.

assign.outcome: **A site-wide right dev rail, behind Ctrl + \.** Three new files (`dev/DevBar/`: shell, tools, css) plus a page and a readme; four one-line edits elsewhere. `dev-open` on `<html>` is the entire state — the slide, the shell push and localStorage all hang off that one class. Dark by `color-scheme: dark` alone: every framework token is a `light-dark()` pair, so the stylesheet names no colour. `.app` now sums TWO inline-end rails (`--drawer + --devbar`), so the rail and ext/layout''s drawer sit side by side instead of on top of each other. Shows route crumbs, viewport in em, socket state, an x-ray outline toggle and jump links.

log.msg: Resize edge: a 2rem hover strip straddling the rail's inline edge, with no permanent splitter — the pill appears at the pointer's Y and rides it. Width persists in localStorage; clamped 200px..innerWidth-200. Dragging sets --rail-ease: 0s, a new token framework.css reads on .app's transition, so the push does not trail the pointer by 0.18s.

Two visibility corrections from Mike at the keyboard. (1) Sizing the pill in `em` gave 3.2 x 12.8, not the 4 x 16 asked for — the rail's text is 0.8rem. rem for every grab-target dimension now. (2) A --subtle (translucent white) pill straddling the boundary is invisible on its left half, which is drawn on the light page: it is --prim now, 6 x 32, with the whole edge lighting at 45% on hover. Findability is the affordance, not the dot.
devbar.css hit 124 lines carrying two responsibilities — the grip's rules moved to grip.css, loaded by grip.js beside it. Every file in the module is under 100 lines again (72/57/51/48/39/83).

assign.outcome: **A site-wide right dev rail, behind Ctrl + \, resizable by its edge.** `dev/DevBar/`: shell, tools, grip, two stylesheets, a page and a readme; five one-line edits elsewhere. `dev-open` on `<html>` is the whole open/closed state and `--dev-rail` on :root is the whole width — the slide, the shell push and both localStorage keys hang off those two.
